environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed as a containerized workload on EKS (using AWS Lambda Web Adapter pattern on Kubernetes). Pod runs in namespace 'profile-svc' with a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applied. The NetworkPolicy spec defines: podSelector matching label app=profile-lookup, policyTypes=['Egress'], egress rules allowing TCP port 3306 to CIDR 10.0.128.0/24 (RDS subnet) and DNS resolution on port 53 to kube-dns. A separate CiliumNetworkPolicy in the same namespace enforces L7 HTTP-aware egress filtering with a rule that intercepts MySQL wire protocol and applies a regex-based SQL audit policy (cilium.io/proxy-visibility annotation) logging queries matching UNION|SLEEP|BENCHMARK patterns. The cluster also runs Falco with a custom rule 'Suspicious SQL Pattern in Profile Service' that triggers on syscall write() containing SQL injection signatures, configured with output to a NATS stream that feeds an OPA admission webhook performing runtime pod termination via eviction API when the rule fires within 50ms detection window.

config.falco_rule: enabled, custom rule with 50ms detection-to-eviction pipeline
